agyos_skill.instructions: Use this for editing an existing recording. It is separate from generated-scene tools, faceless shorts, filming advice, and long-video-to-short clipping. The repository copy is `tools/video/ai-video-editor`. Confirm it contains scripts/transcribe.py, scripts/cut.py, scripts/render.py, engine/player.js, and styles/index.json, then set KIT_ROOT to that path. A user-provided alternate root is also valid. The AGYOS skill does not include or duplicate the renderer. If no toolkit is present, stop at an edit plan and ask for its location; do not invent script paths or claim an export. Use a new, user-approved work directory separate from the source clip. Pass it with transcribe.py's --work option so generated files do not land beside the original recording. Never overwrite an existing work directory or source file. Reuse information the user already gave. Ask together only for choices that affect the edit: language, pause-cut preference, whether to consider retakes, caption preference and writing system, style, graphics density, and whether they want to review the cut and graphics plans. Probe the source dimensions and show the crop consequence before editing any non-16:9 clip; the toolkit center-crops it to 16:9. Defaults from the supplied toolkit are natural pauses retained, obvious silence removed, no captions, light graphics, and Warm Canvas for talking-head footage. Treat those as editable defaults. Preserve the speaker's meaning, sequence, and authentic delivery. Do not remove an ambiguous phrase, rewrite the narration, or infer a retake without review. Before cutting spoken content, show the proposed mistake-cut list with timestamps, transcript text, and reason. Before writing graphics, show the beat list and any visible claims or numbers. Wait for approval unless the user has already authorized those specific edits. Do not render a full video from a storyboard alone. Follow [the toolkit workflow](references/TOOLKIT_WORKFLOW.md). Correct the transcript before planning graphics. Read the selected style's style.md, base.js, and example; use
